metadata.name: GetRejectedTransactions
metadata.description: Purpose of this API is to get all the rejected transaction list.

request_fields.name: Source
request_fields.description: Source of API Consumer For external system expected sources will be WEB. Allowable Values: 50

request_fields.name: IPAddress
request_fields.description: IP Address of Client / Application Hosting Server Example: 10.206.0.204 Allowable Values: 15

request_fields.name: DateFormat
request_fields.description: Place Holder for Future Use. Values are: 1 : MM/dd/yyyy HH:MM:SS (Default) 2 : MM/dd/yy HH:MM:SS 3 : dd/MM/yyyy HH:MM:SS Allowable Values: 25

request_fields.name: CurrencyCode
request_fields.description: Currency Code Place Holder for Future Use. Valid Values: Refer Appendix Section - Currency Code Example:840 = US Dollar Condition:If no value is passed, default value = 840 Allowable Values: 10

request_fields.name: CurrencySymbolType
request_fields.description: Place Holder for Future Use. CurrencySymbolType: 1: Currency Sign like $ 2: 3 ALPHA Currency Code like USD Allowable Values: 10

request_fields.name: Language
request_fields.description: Place Holder for Future Use. Language: en: means use English Default: en - English Allowable Values: 10

request_fields.name: ExternalIP
request_fields.description: IP Address of end user of API Allowable Values: 50

request_fields.name: SessionID
request_fields.description: Session identifier of the API Example: 000028;026;1349906692 Allowable Values: 100

request_fields.name: APIVersion
request_fields.description: Version of the API to be invoked. Example: 2.0 API Version Current Version 2.0 Allowable Values: 10

request_fields.name: CallerID
request_fields.description: Caller ID of source from where API is initiated it is End User Caller ID Example: 7204454214 (phone number applicable in Case of IVR) Allowable Values: 20

request_fields.name: CalledID
request_fields.description: Called ID of destination for which API is initiated It is Destination Called ID Example: 7314145404 (phone number applicable in Case of IVR) Allowable Values: 20

request_fields.name: RequestTime
request_fields.description: Request Date Time of API Format: MM/dd/yyyy HH:mm:ss Example:01/15/2020 10:05:23

request_fields.name: DateFrom
request_fields.description: Start date of rejected  transaction search. Valid Values: 0-9 Format: MM/DD/YYYY Example: 02/01/2020

request_fields.name: DateTo
request_fields.description: End date of rejected  transaction search. Valid Values: 0-9 Format: MM/DD/YYYY Example: 02/01/2020

request_fields.name: MerchantID
request_fields.description: Unique number of merchant account Valid Values:0-9 Format:XXXXX Example:12345 Allowable Values: 20

request_fields.name: ProductID
request_fields.description: Product ID Valid Values:0-9 Format:XXXX Example:1234 Allowable Values: 20

request_fields.name: TransactionsSourceType
request_fields.description: Transactions source like ACH, manual etc. Valid Values: Refer Appendix Section 5.42 (Transaction Source Type). Example:5=IPM, 14= ACH Allowable Values: 20

request_fields.name: BatchStatus
request_fields.description: The current status of the batch. Valid values: 5 = Batch Flagged for Deletion 7 = Batch Flagged for Error(s) 12 = Dispute Resolution Batch 9 = Fraud 1 = In-Balance 3 = Needs Re-posting 11 = Non-Monetary Processed 2 = Out-of-Balance 4 = Posted 10 = Processed 8 = Rejected 16 = Rejected: ACH Auto Return 17 = Rejected: ACH Manual Return 6 = Summary Allowable Values: 20

request_fields.name: AccountNumber
request_fields.description: Account number of cardholder/AccountHolder. Valid Values:0-9 Format:XXXXXXXXXX Example:7314145404 Allowable Values: 19

request_fields.name: BatchID
request_fields.description: The identifier of the batch, which is assigned by the system. Valid Values:0-9 Example:1234 Allowable Values: 19

request_fields.name: TransactionAmount
request_fields.description: Amount of Transaction Valid Values:0-9 Format:  XXX.XX Example:  200.00

request_fields.name: CardAcceptorNameLocation
request_fields.description: Name and location details of merchant Valid Values: a-z A-Z Format: XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX Example: Dental merchant, Nashua Allowable Values: 20

request_fields.name: BatchSize
request_fields.description: Number of Transaction which can be view in one Batch Default Value would be 50. Valid Values:0-9 Format:XX Example:20

request_fields.name: PageIndex
request_fields.description: Number of page Default value would be 0 Valid Values:0-9 Format:XX Example:12

response_fields.name: Status
response_fields.description: API Status Example: Success - true, Error - false

response_fields.name: ErrorCode
response_fields.description: Response Message Error Code Allowable Values: 10

children.name: AdminNumber
children.description: Details can be obtained by admin number (Embossing Acctid) Valid Values:0-9 Format:XXXXX Example:12345

children.name: BatchID
children.description: The identifier of the batch, which is assigned by the system. Valid Values:0-9 Example:1234 Allowable Values: 19

children.name: EffectiveDateTime
children.description: An Effective DateTime is the date upon which posted transaction will be considered to take into effect, which may be a past, present or future date. Valid Values: 0-9 Format: MM/DD/YYYY HH:MM:SS Example:  02/02/2020  20:20:20

children.name: ProductName
children.description: Reflects the name of product for the account Valid Values: a-z Format:xxxxxx Example:abcsolutionsrevolving Allowable Values: 20

children.name: ClientName
children.description: Name of client / institution Valid Values:A-Z,0-9 Format:XXXXXX Example: Company,LLC Allowable Values: 20

children.name: AccountNumber
children.description: Account number of cardholder/AccountHolder. Valid Values:0-9 Format:XXXXXXXXXX Example:7314145404 Allowable Values: 19

children.name: MaskedCardNumber
children.description: Masked Card Number.For security purposes, the card number always displays partially masked with only the first six and last four numbers in the clear. Valid Values:0-9 Example:123456XXXXXX1234 Allowable Values: 19

children.name: CardHolderName
children.description: Name of the Card holder Valid Values:A-Z,0-9 Example: John Joe Allowable Values: 120

children.name: TransactionCode
children.description: A code to identify type of payment. Valid Values:  The valid values of Transaction Code can be fetched from GetTranCodeByUserID API. Format:  xxxxxx Example:427248 = Principal Adjustment Allowable Values: 8

children.name: TransactionAmount
children.description: Amount of Transaction Valid Values:0-9 Format:  XXX.XX Example:  200.00 Allowable Values: 8

children.name: PostingReference
children.description: Posting reference (Like -Transaction Posted Successfully) Valid Values: A-Z 0-9 Format: XXXXXXXXXXXXX Example: Transaction Posted Successfully Allowable Values: 128

children.name: UserID
children.description: User ID provided by CoreCARD Valid Values: a-z,0-9 Format: XXXXXXXXXX Example: Newuser123 Allowable Values: 128

children.name: BatchStatus
children.description: The current status of the batch. Valid values: 5 = Batch Flagged for Deletion 7 = Batch Flagged for Error(s) 12 = Dispute Resolution Batch 9 = Fraud 1 = In-Balance 3 = Needs Re-posting 11 = Non-Monetary Processed 2 = Out-of-Balance 4 = Posted 10 = Processed 8 = Rejected 16 = Rejected: ACH Auto Return 17 = Rejected: ACH Manual Return 6 = Summary Allowable Values: 20

children.name: TransactionID
children.description: Transaction Number for the  transaction being posted. Valid Values:0-9 a-z Format:XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX Example:23654789 Allowable Values: 20

children.name: TransactionDescription
children.description: User defined description of transaction if entered by user explicitly. If not entered by the user, then system will generate it. Valid Values:A-Z,0-9 Format: xxxxxxxx Example:Purchase/Payment. Allowable Values: 200

children.name: CardSequenceNumber
children.description: This tag reflects the Sequence Number of the Card. Valid Values: 0-9 Example: 2
